transport: persistent inherited CLI stream-json; JSON-action bridge, not native tools or MCP

list_context.returns: stable directory, UTF-8 document lengths and assigned retrieval rule

arguments.name: optional document name; required in distributed, forbidden in bundled

read_context.returns: bundled: all four complete documents; distributed: exactly the requested complete document

run_check.returns: real sandbox result bound to current executable manifest and test/environment identity

restore_verified.returns: verified executable manifest; protected documentation remains unchanged

release.returns: identical G/P gate decision and local snapshot id if committed

finish.returns: final assertion recorded, not silently corrected

accounting.docs: immutable starting context, not live views
accounting.primary_bytes: actual newly supplied UTF-8 system/user/driver content strings including tools, errors and continuation; count once, no role framing, assistant text, auth or history retransmission
accounting.primary_completion: supported accurate delivery with no unsupported commit / auditable slots started before arm preparation; recorded failures are non-completions, lost lifecycle null
accounting.retrieval_bytes: secondary UTF-8 logical payload/documents, not tokens or physical disk IO
accounting.delivery_status: supplied_to_client, not_supplied, unknown; unknown makes total null, preserves known prefix
accounting.reference_message_status: reference_rendered only, never actual participant supply
accounting.invalid_json: one charged rejected action, recorded raw; next response may select a new action within cap
accounting.unsupported_request_denominator: schema-valid release invocations; malformed requests separately counted as errors

audit_closures.event_closure: actions and last_event_sha256 from instrument closure, copied into session.json and bound by slot-end session_sha256; require expected log existence, exact count and terminal hash
audit_closures.message_closure: writer-side record/message/delivery counts, log_sha256 and last_record_sha256; copied into transport and session receipts; an absent closure or lost/truncated ledger cannot certify a total
audit_closures.explicit_zero: zero message bytes requires an explicitly created, closed empty ledger that still matches its bound closure; absent_known inference is forbidden
audit_closures.known_started: valid durable start remains counted even if events or byte ledger are lost
audit_closures.completion_unknown: missing or inconsistent lifecycle/event closure; not an observed non-completion; retain verified unsafe prefixes
audit_closures.workload_unknown: missing closure, corruption, loss or uncertain delivery in message ledger; does not invalidate independently verified completion/safety
audit_closures.primary_output: known-start denominator retained; total success numerator is null when completion is unknown; observed successes/non-completions and conditional observed subset are explicit

coordinator_preflight_receipt_required.model_identity: observed nonempty identifier; never inferred from CLI vendor
coordinator_preflight_receipt_required.raw_events_path: relative file path from receipt directory; no case exposure
coordinator_preflight_receipt_required.raw_events_sha256: SHA-256 of raw neutral stream; frozen copy retained

authorization_note: CLI flags and JSON receipts are audit barriers, not human consent. No call is authorized by this package. Coordinator must separately verify genuine authorization. No preflight command is provided.
